description: First ESP32 kit — blinks the DevKit's GPIO 2 LED at an interval inferred from the user's prompt. First-flash over USB via Web Serial; subsequent flashes use ESPHome OTA over WiFi.
author: jengakit

ui.hint: e.g. blink the onboard LED every 250ms, fast SOS pulse, heartbeat once a second
ui.description: Generates an ESPHome YAML config + compiles via the ESPHome sidecar (requires JENGAKIT_ESPHOME_ENABLED=true). First flash over USB; subsequent flashes use the device's OTA endpoint.

sample_prompts: Slow heartbeat pulse on the onboard LED
SOS pattern — three short, three long, three short, repeating
